name: kirocrew-acp-adapters
description: The exact version of each ACP adapter the installers (install.sh, setup.sh, minimal_install.sh) put on PATH with `npm install -g <name>@<version>`. Read through scripts/lib/acp-adapter-pin.sh; nothing here is installed from this directory. Exact versions only: a range or `latest` would let an install pick up a release published minutes earlier. Dependabot proposes a bump weekly, after a 7-day cooldown. To bump by hand: edit the exact version, keep it at or above CLAUDE_ACP_SETTING_SOURCES_MIN_VERSION in src/kiro_crew/acp/client_claude_session.py, and run test/test_installer_pins.py.
